The '''Sword Armor''' is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''.''

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:ArmorSwordManL.gif|80px]]

Sword Armors first appear in [[Basilisk Mine Field|Act 4-2]]. They are palette swaps of the [[Biker]] and [[Sword Man]] and do the same thing, equipped with a scimitar. They only deal 1 point of damage on contact, and are easily defeated in one hit by any attack.
